reply.summary: Stirnose is a lean sellsword-paladin who guards a realm of honey-coloured spires, answering every threat with a lacquered staff and patient footwork. Rumour says the crown pays him in sunlight.

feats.scene: Stirnose snaps a siege ram in half with one pivoting staff strike.
Stirnose takes a collapsing gatehouse beam across the shoulders and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Urnrncor is a masked street guardian whose coil-gloves crackle with stored current. Fearless to the end, Urnrncor challenges a grieving fire-eyed titan and falls in a single heartbeat of heat.

feats.scene: Urnrncor discharges both gauntlets into a steel shutter and blows it off its rails.
Urnrncor shrugs off a flung delivery van before the final beam lands.

reply.summary: Iaronnum is a vigilante who uploaded a dying mind into a grown-in-a-vat body and woke up as a squalling infant. Undeterred, Iaronnum rules the rooftops from a padded harness and a crib fitted with turrets.

feats.scene: Iaronnum fires a crib-mounted cannon that cracks a thug's armoured car in two.
Iaronnum rides out a rooftop collapse inside a reinforced nursery shell.

reply.summary: Ances is a gun-toting avenger who stockpiled hidden arsenals across a sprawling port city and treats mercy as a flaw. Ances hunts the corrupt with sniper patience and a trophy wall of spent cartridges.

feats.scene: Ances detonates a hidden weapons cache and brings a banquet hall down on its guests.
Ances walks away from a point-blank shotgun blast fired through a doorway.

reply.summary: Orovalora is a grappling-line tactician who rides flying invaders across rooftops and sewers to dismantle their sabotage. Orovalora trains a young heir and trusts only well-made gadgets and a cool head.

feats.scene: Orovalora cracks a hovering invader's carapace with a weighted cable swing.
Orovalora clings to a fleeing flyer through a wall of brick and glass.
Orovalora is towed at highway speed across the skyline on a swinging line.

reply.summary: Ernlonin is a weary, scarred vigilante and founder of a coalition of gifted defenders, combining armour, explosives and brutal close-quarters skill. Ernlonin is most dangerous when cornered and angry.

feats.scene: Ernlonin rams a plated war machine through a warehouse wall and levels the front half.
Ernlonin stands in a crushed hangar and takes a collapsing girder on a reinforced frame.

reply.summary: Serll is a doomed elder brother remembered only through a bitter sibling's confession, a proud child cut down in a lane alongside kin. Serll never lived long enough to be anything but a ghost story.

feats.scene: Serll shields a smaller boy with his own body for one terrible second.

reply.summary: Seesres is a disciplined cape-and-cowl brawler fighting to a code, fitted with a pouch of tricks and years of hard sparring. Seesres teaches a headstrong son to hold back a punch.

feats.scene: Seesres drops three armed raiders in the span of one breath.
Seesres tumbles down a stairwell and rises ready to fight.

reply.summary: Tortellu is a grey-skinned ruin of a man who injected himself with a plague of monstrous growth and now shifts at will into a bone-spiked brute. Tortellu serves a dread patron, fast and heavy and horribly hard to kill.

feats.scene: Tortellu hurls a fortress turret across a canyon and levels a block of houses.
Tortellu shakes off a tank-barrage volley and regrows torn ribs in seconds.
Tortellu bounds across a ruined plain faster than a rifle round.

reply.summary: Arnas is a blood-drunk conqueror who wears an ancient helm that feeds a hunger for battle. Arnas crosses burning kingdoms, a one-eyed warlord crowned with the fury of a war deity.

feats.scene: Arnas brings a whole walled capital to rubble with a single sweeping helm-fuelled charge.
Arnas wades through a catapult barrage and a lightning storm unbowed.

reply.summary: Astse is a green-lit zealot who bent a stolen ring of will to a fallen patron's service. Astse paints sector skies with glowing constructs and brags about the dawn that will never come.

feats.scene: Astse hurls a ring-built comet and cracks a mountain from root to peak.
Astse weathers a salvo of orbital lances behind a lime-bright dome.
Astse rockets out of the atmosphere in a green streak.

reply.summary: Terniil is a hardened ex-ally who kept a viral weapon as insurance and finally turned it against a sunny idol. Terniil transforms into a grey, red-eyed wrecker who crushes walls and cities alike.

feats.scene: Terniil razes a metropolis district in a rampage that lasts one long evening.
Terniil absorbs a point-blank missile volley and mutates new plating on the spot.
Terniil outruns a supersonic jet across a ruined skyline.

reply.summary: Erenus is a one-eyed conqueror whose war-god helm drowned every scruple under a lust for victory. Erenus sweeps across worlds with a blade that never dulls, humbling gods and armies alike.

feats.scene: Erenus cleaves a mountain range in two with one overhead sweep of an ember-bright sword.
Erenus laughs off a mountain-sized rockfall brought down on his helm.

reply.summary: Stieonan is a hollowed-out crimefighter who let a patient father-machine remove fear, sorrow and finally flesh. Stieonan walks as a red-eyed chassis that learns from every wound.

feats.scene: Stieonan punches through a reactor wall and floods a block with shrapnel.
Stieonan walks out of a collapsing foundry with only dented plating.

reply.summary: Tiutalri is a ray-shaped aquatic avenger born in a bright pastel realm after a childhood tragedy. Tiutalri glides through harbour water and tail-whips smugglers off their decks.

feats.scene: Tiutalri slaps a smuggler's skiff clear of the water with one tail sweep.
Tiutalri rides a harbour-wall wave and surfaces unhurt.
Tiutalri skims the swell faster than a motor launch.

reply.summary: Vanolll is a plate-clad champion who swore an oath in front of an empty suit of armour and now carries sword and boomerang blades into a ten-person fellowship. Vanolll marches into crowds of shambling dead without flinching.

feats.scene: Vanolll cuts a bronze portcullis free with a single sweeping sword stroke.
Vanolll stands in his plate while a stone ogre pounds on his helm.

reply.summary: Amoser is a venom-stinger vigilante from a grim, soot-choked reality who fights alongside a squad of weary defenders. Amoser perished in a cosmic rampage and was later restored whole.

feats.scene: Amoser drives a barbed tail-spike through a vault door.
Amoser crawls from a flattened bunker with a grin and a limp.

reply.summary: Vastoter is a smug corporate chief who lost a licensing bid to a rival and then lost his life to a laughing assassin. Vastoter spent more on boardroom suits than on armour.

feats.scene: Vastoter slams a fist down on a boardroom table and cracks the veneer.
Vastoter survives a stumble down an escalator with only a bruised ego.

reply.summary: Tiunauli is a gaslit-era industrialist who prowls foggy alleys in a winged hood, hunting a ripper of the night while the constabulary hunts him. Tiunauli studied under a famed dream-doctor before taking up the hood.

feats.scene: Tiunauli knocks a coachman off his perch with a hooked cane swing.
Tiunauli tumbles from a steamer's funnel into a dock crate and stands up.

reply.summary: Sauore is an aged strategist with surgically bolted braces who directs younger champions from a cavern lair. Sauore weighs every fight against the cost in lives, preferring clever proxies to open battle.

feats.scene: Sauore directs an exo-frame fist through a steel hatch.
Sauore endures a hard fall from a cavern ledge in his bracing.

reply.summary: Nusrnu is a cowled father who wed a fellow mask-wearer and now raises a mischievous boy with the same name. Nusrnu patrols by night and coaches a fidgety child between rooftop jumps.

feats.scene: Nusrnu flips a mugger over one shoulder and pins him to a fire escape.
Nusrnu shields his son from a tumbling pile of crates.

reply.summary: Teltia is a clever orphan adopted into a farm family who teams up with a gifted step-sibling as a teenage crime-stopper. Teltia grows into a brilliant scientist and fighter who dodges a master swindler's traps.

feats.scene: Teltia cracks a gang's getaway truck with a gadget-boosted kick.
Teltia is flung through a barn door and keeps scrapping.

reply.summary: Orecornum is a hopeful, patient duplicate sculpted from the best traits of a broken original, serving as master builder of the last walled city on a ruined planet. Orecornum keeps the mad outside the walls with clockwork engineering.

feats.scene: Orecornum triggers a city-wide gear array that grinds an invading mob's war-wagon to scrap.
Orecornum rides out a tower collapse inside a sealed vault pod.

reply.summary: Iumestti is an aging first-generation defender in a far-future timeline, retired from the field with a chronic back injury and a regret about what he became. Iumestti passes a mantle to a young protege.

feats.scene: Iumestti drops a dockside bruiser with a veteran's economical counter.
Iumestti stays upright after a cargo net swings him into a gantry.

reply.summary: Cortel is a leather-clad enforcer who wears an electrified suit, rides a roaring cycle and relies on terror above all. Cortel serves a scheming tycoon until a rebellion finally ends the reign.

feats.scene: Cortel rams his cycle through a barricade of oil drums.
Cortel absorbs a rocket's blast in his charged suit.
Cortel tears down a wasteland highway at full throttle.

reply.summary: Roslornia is a teenage scion expelled from a stuffy boarding school for standing up to bullies, then shipped back to a rough public school. Roslornia is orphaned, earnest and caught in a plot beyond classroom drama.

feats.scene: Roslornia throws a hard punch at a locker bully and bloodies his lip.
Roslornia takes a shove into a trophy case without falling.

reply.summary: Ornum is a veteran night-prowler with a crossbow, a lair full of screens and a trick for slipping out of any binding. Ornum is murdered by a secret society of masked patricians and the guilt lands on an adoptive heir.

feats.scene: Ornum blasts a locked lab door with a shaped charge.
Ornum survives a tumble through a skylight and keeps pursuit.

reply.summary: Vaviau is a picture-book hero who guards a metropolis from a satellite perch and leaves his adopted wards to grow independent. Vaviau chases a living stone dragon through a museum until two famous allies help calm it.

feats.scene: Vaviau yanks a rope that topples a display case onto a rampaging statue.
Vaviau is swatted into a museum wall by a stone tail and climbs to his feet.

reply.summary: Nelveo is a devout man of the cloth turned masked rebel after discovering that a ruling church had silenced his physician parents. Nelveo rallies a hidden underground against a theocratic empire.

feats.scene: Nelveo breaks an inquisitor's staff over a pillar and sends the guard sprawling.
Nelveo bears the lash of a dozen whips in silence.

reply.summary: Teoraria is a long-dead founding hero whose recorded final words inspire a far-future rebel to take up the hood. Teoraria fell in battle against a grinning nemesis, leaving a legacy that his heirs twist into tyranny.

feats.scene: Teoraria hurls a weighted blade through a fortress door in his last stand.
Teoraria fights on through a rain of shots before falling.

reply.summary: Anunus is a lone observatory-keeper who chose a falling spark of light as an omen to become a symbol of good fortune against superstitious villains. Anunus tosses glittering charms and fights with quick steps.

feats.scene: Anunus hurls a glittering charm that bursts against a thug's chest.
Anunus drops from the observatory dome and lands in a roll.

reply.summary: Leoinu is a gadget-happy, tactically minded fighter in a ragged gang-war fantasy of mismatched costumes. Leoinu tinkers with toys and studies the field, leading an eccentric crew against rival costumed brawlers.

feats.scene: Leoinu fires a grapple gun that yanks a rival off a gantry.
Leoinu shrugs off a brawl through a fruit stall and a plate-glass window.

reply.summary: Reoseo is a wealthy crimefighter recruited to a multiversal army when a thief starts targeting antique dealers. Reoseo chases suspects over rooftops with a belt of gadgets, and learns the true culprit is no thief at all.

feats.scene: Reoseo smashes a display case and a masked thief's wrist with one swing.
Reoseo rides out an alley explosion with a scorched cloak.

reply.summary: Rnsilte is a haunted fighter who builds sonic weapons to answer the memory of gunfire. Rnsilte joins a multiversal alliance and defends a lamplit city from swarming drones.

feats.scene: Rnsilte focuses a sonic cannon that shatters a drone squadron mid-flight.
Rnsilte braces behind a sound-baffled shield while the street rattles apart.

reply.summary: Reoros is a small, wide-eyed boy playing at a mansion gate who meets a strange visitor, watches a quarrel, and later loses his parents in a riot. Reoros has no powers, only a child's curiosity.

feats.scene: Reoros tosses a pebble at the manor gate's iron bars.
Reoros tumbles onto the cobbles and bounces back up with scuffed knees.

reply.summary: Eoiumse is a methodical file-keeper who catalogues every ally's weakness and every rival's habits. Eoiumse resists a swarm of mind-controlling nanites and helps free captive loved ones with an interrogation and a plan.

feats.scene: Eoiumse subdues a frost-wielding thug with a tight hold and a quick toss.
Eoiumse fights off a nanite takeover long enough to be rescued.

reply.summary: Telamo is a cinematic nocturnal crimefighter who drives a heavy armoured car, uses throwing blades, and trains a trio of young partners. Telamo has been through trial after trial and keeps coming back.

feats.scene: Telamo flips an armoured van with a ramming turn of the car.
Telamo crashes through a rooftop skylight and walks it off.

reply.summary: Niutorti is a rich heir whose parents were saved from a mugging by a kind visitor from the stars, so he never became a masked crimefighter. Niutorti grows up comfortable, and a later terrorist attack leaves a mark.

feats.scene: Niutorti shoves a mugger away from his mother in the street.
Niutorti is knocked sprawling and gets up shaking.

reply.summary: Stullo is a tyrant of a ruined tower-city, a once-noble defender broken by the world's betrayal and rebuilt through ruthless planning. Stullo rules with a clone at his side and a bitter dream of saving everyone by force.

feats.scene: Stullo calls down a rooftop cannon that levels an apartment tower.
Stullo survives a toppling spire in a reinforced throne-room.

reply.summary: Seotil is an elderly husband and father who lived long enough to marry a former thief and raise a daughter, passing quietly in the family home. Seotil spent a lifetime hiding goodness behind grim habit.

feats.scene: Seotil lifts his weight in an old struggle with a gala bomber.
Seotil endures an ice-rink blast with a scorched sleeve.

reply.summary: Amotautum is a blocky plastic-brick hero who trained with a shadowy order, collects colour-coded rings and earns his keep in a toy-box city. Amotautum swaps costumes between a gloomy cape and a glowing ring corps.

feats.scene: Amotautum wallops a brick-built robot and scatters it across the courtyard.
Amotautum pops back together after a plastic-shattering explosion.
Amotautum zooms across a toy skyline in a ring-powered dash.

reply.summary: Iunticol is a cool boardroom executive who builds a task force to hunt gifted people, then bankrolls a team of them after seeing a heroic debut. Iunticol never dons a mask and fights with budgets and politics.

feats.scene: Iunticol slams a contract on a conference table hard enough to rattle glasses.
Iunticol endures a chaotic press conference without flinching.

reply.summary: Riaam is a cartoon crimefighter who keeps a cold-case drawer of old arrests and an eye for detail. Riaam helps a rubbery reformed crook solve a decades-old puzzle by comparing a torn shirt and a monitor face.

feats.scene: Riaam hurls a bladed boomerang that pins a crook's sleeve to a wall.
Riaam bounces off a cartoon anvil and straightens his cowl.

reply.summary: Orcont is a moody teenage balladeer in a band of butlers' kids, discovered and then dropped by a record mogul after a spiral of addiction. Orcont tours in a van and sings plaintive verses about loneliness.

feats.scene: Orcont smashes a guitar against an amplifier at the end of a set.
Orcont stage-dives into a crowd that forgets to catch him.

reply.summary: Valiaros is a young orphan turned shadowy city guardian who works through a loose network of informants. Valiaros chases a childhood killer, clashes with a flying hero, and then cooperates with him against the real villains.

feats.scene: Valiaros breaks a thug's arm with a quick wrist lock in a stairwell.
Valiaros survives a tainted-bullet ambush with a vest and sheer luck.

reply.summary: Ausntoiu is a green-haired, greasepaint-faced murderer who killed kin as a child and stalked victims as an adult. Ausntoiu chases a witness through a portal before a rival version of himself locks him away with a far-off warden.

feats.scene: Ausntoiu strangles a rival in a single vicious twist of a wire.
Ausntoiu is hurled through a portal and tumbles up laughing.

reply.summary: Ciltin is a cynical gun-carrying shadow from an older era who helped a flying hero fight patchwork monsters and a famous vampire. Ciltin turns up decades later at a birthday party with a sneer about hope.

feats.scene: Ciltin drops a patchwork monster's grip with a twin-pistol volley.
Ciltin is slung against a laboratory wall and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Valciscor is a lone resister who fights invaders in secret, leaving neither survivors nor proof. Valciscor refuses to join an alliance until pushed, then rides with a ragged band on a doomed last stand.

feats.scene: Valciscor wrecks an invader refinery with timed charges and walks off before the fireball.
Valciscor stands in a sealed arena while alien hordes press in.

reply.summary: Torrneval is a patient planner who spends two decades preparing to avenge his parents against a secret corporation of hoarded wonders. Torrneval gathers other aggrieved heirs and storms a hidden moon base.

feats.scene: Torrneval sets a breaching charge and blows open a base airlock.
Torrneval walks through a hail of lunar gunfire in a pressure suit.

reply.summary: Lonvareo is a masked mentor in a bright cartoon world who guides a bubbly young heroine on her first cases. Lonvareo keeps a belt of tricks and fights tiny pests and big bruisers alike.

feats.scene: Lonvareo flips a cartoon bruiser through a billboard.
Lonvareo brushes soot from his cowl after a cartoon explosion.
